marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 to 20 knots diminishing to light this evening
then increasing to northwest 15 to 20 Thursday morning. Wind diminishing to
light late Thursday afternoon. Scattered showers overnight and Thursday morning. Fog
patches forming after midnight and dissipating early Thursday
morning. <br/>
